tagline: A global player in the branded spirits industry.
hero_kpi_rationale: The EBIT margin of 21.7% reflects the group's strong operational profitability, with an improvement of +3.2 percentage points vs 2016. This is a key structural indicator of the spirits business model, demonstrating operational efficiency and cost management.

kpis.name: Net sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue after deduction of returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Net sales grew 5.2% in 2017, driven by strong organic demand (+6.3%).
kpis.signal: Double-digit organic growth in a mature sector.

kpis.name: Operating income
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest and taxes, measuring operational profitability.
kpis.description: EBIT increased significantly in 2017, rising from €319.4M to €394.3M.
kpis.signal: Substantial improvement in operating margin through efficiency gains.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by net sales.
kpis.description: EBIT margin reached 21.7% in 2017 versus 18.5% in 2016, supported by cost savings and improved product mix.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of sales.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of industrial and commercial performance.

kpis.name: Net debt
kpis.explanation: Total financial debt minus cash and cash equivalents.

kpis.name: Free cash flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations after capital investments.
kpis.description: FCF stood at €227.0M in 2017, down from €243.2M in 2016.
kpis.signal: Strong cash generation capacity despite sustained capex.

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees at period end.
kpis.description: The group had 4,020 employees in 2017 versus 4,172 in 2016.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €8.11B in latest year

risks.title: Distributor dependence and concentration
risks.score_rationale: Major risk for the spirits sector: the group relies heavily on distributors such as Southern Glazer's Wine & Spirits (SGWS) in North America and new partners in China (Yuanliu). Moderate language but central position in commercial strategy. Stable trend but structural risk.

risks.title: Geographic concentration and US market dependence
risks.score_rationale: Carolans and Irish Mist generated 70% of US sales (2% of group in 2016). While these brands were divested, the portfolio remains heavily oriented toward the USA (Wild Turkey, SKYY, Appleton). High structural risk of geographic concentration.

risks.title: Non-core brand risk and portfolio rationalization
risks.score_rationale: Divestiture of Carolans, Irish Mist, Lapostolle, Château de Sancerre in 2017 indicates portfolio rationalization strategy. Neutral language but high frequency of divestitures. Upward trend: accelerating rationalization to reduce debt.

risks.title: Acquisition volatility and brand integration
risks.score_rationale: Acquisition of Bulldog Gin (USD 55M + earn-out USD 28.6M) in February 2017, with future performance clause. Moderate language but earn-out and integration risk. Stable trend but recurring acquisition pattern.

risks.title: Tax regulation and preferential regime dependence
risks.score_rationale: Italian patent box (agreement 2017-2019) generated €44.8M tax benefit in 2017. US tax reform (rate reduction 35% to 21%) created one-time benefit of €81.9M. Neutral language but dependence on temporary regimes. Upward trend: growing exposure to regulatory changes.

risks.title: Counterfeiting risk and intellectual property protection
risks.score_rationale: Aperol redesign to 'differentiate from imitators' indicates counterfeiting pressure. Explicit language but unquantified. Stable trend but structural to premium spirits sector.

risks.title: Key brand performance dependence and product innovation
risks.score_rationale: Multiple 2017 launches (SKYY Infusions, Wild Turkey Master's Keep, Appleton Estate Joy) indicate constant innovation need. Moderate language but high launch frequency. Stable trend but rising competitive intensity.

risks.title: Alcohol regulatory risk and marketing restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Major marketing campaigns (Campari Calendar with Paolo Sorrentino, Wild Turkey with Matthew McConaughey) indicate exposure to alcohol marketing regulation. Neutral language but advertising dependence for growth. Stable trend but rising restriction risk.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the 2017 annual report. The company does not position AI as a strategic lever.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced automation.
Absence of digital projects or technology innovation related to AI.
Focus on traditional product innovation (launches, flavors, packaging).
